faq_heading: Homes near Cedar Hills Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Cedar Hills Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Cedar Hills Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Cedar Hills Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Cedar Hills Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 55 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,050,000, townhomes $592,450, condos $329,400. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Cedar Hills Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Cedar Hills Elementary the median was 44 days on the market, closing at 95.3% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 55 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Cedar Hills Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Prince Charles Elementary (0.5 km north), L.A. Matheson Secondary (0.7 km south-west) and Senator Reid Elementary (1.0 km south-east).

Cedar Hills Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 12370 98 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Cedar Hills Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Cedar Hills Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Cedar Hills Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Cedar Hills Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 55 homes sold within 1 km of Cedar Hills Elementary: 33 houses, 10 townhomes and 8 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,050,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Cedar Hills Elementary

25 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Cedar Hills Elementary in a straight line (17 elementary, 6 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Prince Charles Elementary, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Kennedy Trail Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is L.A. Matheson Secondary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa Secondary School (Surrey) (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Kwantlen Park Secondary (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Prince Charles Elementary (0.5 km north), Senator Reid Elementary (1.0 km south-east), Kirkbride Elementary (1.2 km south), Royal Heights Elementary (1.4 km west), David Brankin Elementary (1.5 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Prince Charles Elementary, 0.5 km north of Cedar Hills Elementary.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Cedar Hills Elementary was $1,050,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
